name: Uesato Momiji
source:
A girl who was in the same class as Gen and Umihiko in school. At that time, she had been Yamahiko's girlfriend. Now she works as a hostess at a local snack bar. Why does she act like she doesn't remember Yamahiko or Umihiko?

[translated from [url=http://ugcp.sakura.ne.jp/umiyama_home/momiji.html]character page[/url]]
